Full soft-UI redesign: extruded 3D cards, carved-in chips, 6 color themes (tap the 🎨 button in the header: Black, White, Red, Gold, Silver, Blue).

New layout: Empire status ring, accent action bar, Quick Access grid, Guardian hero card, Empire Status stats + permissions progress bar.

Every feature preserved and reorganized: Guardian, Screenshot + Bubble, 20 Live Wallpapers, Power Tools, Cleaner, Vault, Dial, Talk, 3D Launcher, Quran, Ghost Mode, Updates, Permissions, What's New.
